paite: TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak gamsung a thahsa mi ana om a, athatmi theih louh ahihleh,
heading: Athattu Theih Louh Tualthahna Toh Kisai

paite: na upate uh leh na vaihawmtute uh ahong pai ding ua, athahna kim khua a pan ateh ding ua,
huan hichi ahi ding a, aluang a pan kho naipen khua a upate'n bawnghon lak a bawngla, zat nai louh, hakkol po nai lou akai ding uhi.
Huai khua upate'n bawngla, tui luanna, lei leh louh leh bangmah chinlouhna phaizang ah akaisuk ding ua, phaizang ah angawng atan ding uh.
Levi tapa siampute'n ahon zuan ding ua, amau TOUPA na Pathian un anasemmi leh TOUPA min a vualzawlmi dia asehte uh lah ahi ngal ua; thubuai leh kivuak thu agen bangbang uh ahi ding ahi.
Luang naihpen khua upa tengteng in phaizang a bawngla ngawng atan tung uah akhut uh asil ding uhi.
"Ka khut un hiai sisan asuah kei a, ka mit un leng amu sam kei.
TOUPA aw, na tatkhiak, na mi Israelte lak ah poi khoih lou sisan suahna moh hon khusak ke'n," chi in apang ding uhi. Huchi in sisan thu ah ngaihdam ahi ding uhi.
Huchibang in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih hih in poi khoih lou sisan suahna na lak ua kipan na koihmang ding uhi.
Na melmate uh dou dia na kipatkhiak ua, TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piak a, sal a na pi ua,
heading: Galmat Numei Toh Kisai

paite: sal lak a numei melhoihtak, na mi deihlam, zi ding a na mi deihlamtak na muhleh,
na inn ah na pi dia; alu amet dia, akhutchin atan ding hi.
Asal puanak asuahkhe dia, na inn ah a-om dia, kha khat sung anu leh apa asuun dia, huai khit in, na kithuahpih dia, apasal na hi dia, amah na zi ahi ding hi.
Amah a kipahna na neih keileh a-utna peuh a pai na phal ding ahi, sum-le-pai in na zuak ding ahi kei a, sumsinna in na zang ding leng ahi kei, amah na daisakta ngal a.
Mi'n zi nih nei henla, khat pen deih in khat pen ho taleh, adeihnu leh ahuatnu in ta suansak tuak taleh; a upapen ahuatnu tapa hitaleh;
heading: Tapa Khatna Goutan Toh Kisai

paite: agou neih atapate akhopsak hun chiang in adeihpen tapa, atapa upa ahuat pen ta sang a deihsakna apiak tuam ding ahi kei.
Ahuat pen ta, ata upapen, aneih tengteng a pan tan nih huai a dia abawl ding ahi; ahatna bul ahi a, tachil hihna ama a tuam ahi.
Mi'n tapa phengphitak, helhattak nei henla, anu leh apa thumang lou in, asawina uh limsakta keileh;
heading: Thumang Lou Tapa Toh Kisai

paite: anu leh apa'n akai ding ua, akho upate uh kiang ah akhokulh kongpi bul ah api ding uhi.
Akho upate uh kiang ah, hiai ka tapa uh phengphitak leh helhattak ahi a, ka thu uh leng amang nuam kei a; kizatbei hat leh kham hatmi ahi, achi ding uhi.
Huchi in khua a mi tengteng in suang in adenglum ding uhi. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi. Israel mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding uhi.
Mi'n sihna khop khelhna ahih a, thah a om a, sing dawn a na khai uleh;
heading: Dan Tuamtuam

paite: aluang sing ah zankhua in a-om ding ahi kei. Huai ni mahmah in na vui ding uhi. Sing a khai peuhmah lah Pathian hamsethuak ahi ngal a. TOUPA na Pathian un luah ding a ahon piak na gam uh na hihnitlouhna ding un.
